description: Use this after design_pose to follow the design: pass its design_id every 20-30 seconds until the status is done, refused or failed (a design takes about 3-6 minutes). Done: the new pose's @handle, description and pictures; write "@<character> in @<new_handle>" in generate_image or generate_video. Refused: why, and a doable alternative to design instead; nothing is charged. Free.
name: check_pose_design
title: Check Pose Design
